title: FIELD SKETCH - blind-a-office
interpretations: Sketch header reads 'FIELD SKETCH - blind-a-office ... * field measured w/ tape', so all pen numbers are treated as stated tape measurements (mainline path), not estimates.

Room is a plain rectangle: 12'-6" appears on both the top (north) and bottom (south) walls, 10'-2" on both the left (west) and right (east) walls. Opposite walls agree, so the polygon closes exactly with the stated values.
Runs are recorded clockwise from the NW corner: E 12'-6" (north wall), S 10'-2" (east wall), W 12'-6" (south wall), N 10'-2" (west wall).

The break in the east wall is the door: 'DR 3'-0"' labels the opening width. The vertical 2'-8" dimension at far right runs from the NE corner down to the near (north) jamb of the opening, so at = 2'-8" measured from the start corner of run 1 (the NE corner). Checks: 2'-8" + 3'-0" leaves 4'-6" of wall below the opening; no chain is written on the plan for that wall, so no parts are recorded.

The drawn gap in the east wall looks slightly wider than 3'-0" at sketch scale, but this is a not-to-scale field sketch; per the skill the pen number governs and was not blended with any pixel measurement.
Door height is not stated; h is omitted so the build flags the 80" DEFAULT.
No swing arc or hinge side is drawn. hinge is a required enum, not a dimension, so it cannot be an {assumed} object; 'near' is recorded here as an arbitrary choice and must be confirmed at review.
Wall thickness and sill are not on the plan; both fields are omitted so house defaults (4" / 48") apply.
job is set to 'a-office' from the working folder name; the sketch title calls it 'blind-a-office'.
